notes: 400 invalid_request_error with code context_length_exceeded: the request is well-formed, the target model's window is too small. Same shape as the 400 tier of openai/error.json; only the code distinguishes it. Sibling wording in the wild (LiteLLM is_error_str_context_window_exceeded, read 2026-10-09): "maximum context limit", "exceed context limit", "input tokens exceed the configured limit".
